assets.title: Water onto embers
assets.role: A short rounded steam hiss as a little water quenches glowing wood embers
assets.prompt: TrackType: SFX, Fire extinguishing sound: a little water poured onto a small glowing wood fire makes one short continuous soft sizzling steam hiss, pssshhh. A warm breathy midrange sizzle with tiny wet woody sputters underneath, a small splash followed by gentle sustained hissing steam that quickly dies away. Close clear dry flat outdoor sound, quiet restrained intensity. Length: 5 seconds.

assets.title: Water onto charred wood
assets.role: A soft continuous watery sizzle over hot charred wood, followed by quiet
assets.prompt: TrackType: SFX, Close gentle water-on-fire quenching.
